articles.summary: Insurers across the board are reporting higher customer adoption of digital channels over the past year. However, a recent Bain survey indicates that high digital channel adoption among property and casualty (P&C) insurers does not necessarily translate to high Net Promoter Scores (NPS)1. These results remind me of a recent question posed to me by an industry analyst: Has digital transformation succeeded or failed in P&C insurance? One answer based on this survey is that while there have been pockets of success, there is still room for improvement in P&C insurance.
articles.title: Succeeding with Digital Transformation
